Events, codes & gifts

Timed events from the Tallgrass team, redeem codes, Halloween and daily gifts.

Timed eventsCodesHalloweenGifts

Timed events

The Tallgrass team runs timed events that show as a banner with a countdown. Several can run at once (the biggest boost of each kind counts).

EventExample
ShinyShiny, Void and Prismatic finds are 2x as likely everywhere but Day Care eggs and the Battle Tower
CrystalVoid and Prismatic finds are 2x as likely everywhere but Day Care eggs and the Battle Tower
ExpEvery battle gives 2x EXP
MoneyBattles pay 2x money
OutbreakA Mass Outbreak of Pikachu on Sunny Shore (Events → Outbreaks)
RaidEvery raid also pays 1 bonus Pikachu Raid Egg

Codes

Got a code from Discord, a stream or an event? Settings → Help → Redeem a code. Each trainer can use a code once; its reward arrives as a gift card.

Halloween

  • Halloween costume Pokémon (Ghost Charmander, Shades Squirtle, Pumpkin Bulbasaur) appear in a daily costume outbreak and on bounty boards while Spooky season is open (until November 9).
  • Until 09 Nov 2026, parents in a Halloween costume pass it on to their babies.

Gifts

  • Daily gift: the Poké Mart leaves balls in your Bag once a UTC day (see How the hunt works).
  • Friend gifts: send one a day to each friend; open up to 10 a day (see Friends).
